title: Value Innovation
equation: Value Innovation = (New Buyer Value Created) × (Cost Reduced)
hook: Competing on the same features as everyone else just means fighting over the same customers.
statement: Be different and lower cost at the same time to create a real jump in value for buyers.
explainer: Drop the expensive stuff customers don't care about, then add something they've never had. Do both and you're not competing harder. You're in a market where rivals can't easily follow.
sop: List every factor your industry competes on.
Mark each one: eliminate, reduce, raise, or create.
Drop costly factors customers don't actually value.
Add new factors that create real value.
Score New Buyer Value Created and Cost Reduced from 1 to 10.
equation_example: New Buyer Value Created 8, Cost Reduced 7. 8 × 7 = 56 Value Innovation, out of 100. Higher means a real leap in value at lower cost, basically a new market. Lower means you're still trading value for cost like everyone else.
question: Write down one thing to eliminate, reduce, raise, and create in your offer.
closing_statement: Redesign the game instead of playing it better.
caption:
Principle Nº 271: Value Innovation

Competing on the same features as everyone else just means fighting over the same customers.

Be different and lower cost at the same time to create a real jump in value for buyers.

Your turn: Write down one thing to eliminate, reduce, raise, and create in your offer.
